svg.title: Thirty days of imitation: deceptive share and shortfall by enforcement and seller policy
svg.desc: Small multiples by placement of the per-day mean over 30 paired seeds with 95% bands, naive versus adaptive sellers. The summary gives every value.
svg.text: Thirty days of imitation: deceptive share and shortfall by enforcement and seller policy
At posts, adaptive − naive deceptive share over days 26–30: −0.3 points [−1.1, +0.6]
Bazaar engine 0.6.0; 2 uniformed inspectors, recognition range 0 (adaptive sellers react to catch notices only). Lines: mean over 30 paired seeds; bands: 95% t-interval per day.
Imitation between days: revise 0.2, mutation 0.02, per-category normaliser; switching cost 0 (placeholder).
